findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key appended as a query parameter: ?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX
findings.actual: API key in query parameter returns 401; the API strictly requires the API key in the 'X-API-Key' request header.
findings.how_found: Sent GET request with api_key query parameter; server returned HTTP 401: 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'.
findings.impact: All requests following documented query parameter auth fail with 401 Unauthorized.

findings.documented: POST /auth/login returns token with expires_in 86400 (24 hours). There is no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns 'access_token' and 'refresh_token' with expires_in 900 (15 minutes). Undocumented POST /auth/refresh exists and is required to maintain the session.
findings.how_found: Inspected POST /auth/login response and verified token refresh via POST /auth/refresh using refresh_token.
findings.impact: User session expires after 15 minutes instead of 24 hours unless the undocumented refresh endpoint is used.

findings.documented: Every collection endpoint takes page (1-indexed) and limit (maximum 200).
findings.actual: Collection endpoints use offset and limit. The 'page' parameter is quietly ignored, and limit is hard-capped at 50 rather than 200.
findings.how_found: Tested page=2 and saw offset remained 0; requested limit=200 and received limit=50 in response.
findings.impact: Clients attempting page-based pagination stay on offset 0 forever, and requesting >50 records returns only 50.

findings.documented: Collection responses are shaped with total, page, page_size, and results.
findings.actual: Envelope does not return 'page' or 'page_size'. Instead it returns 'limit', 'offset', 'count', 'total', 'has_more', 'results'.
findings.how_found: Inspected response envelope structure on all collection endpoints.
findings.impact: Frontend code expecting response.page or response.page_size encounters KeyError or undefined errors.

findings.documented: total is the exact number of records matching your filters. To fetch every record, read total, divide by your limit, and request that many pages.
findings.actual: The reported total on /v1/listings is 4348, but the endpoint serves 4700 records when paged until has_more is false.
findings.how_found: Paged past offset 4348 using limit=50 and continued receiving 50 records per page until reaching offset 4700.
findings.impact: Clients calculating page iterations from the total field miss 352 records.

findings.actual: GET /v1/listing/{id} returns 404 Not Found. The endpoint is plural: GET /v1/listings/{id}.
findings.impact: Listing detail views crash with 404 if using the documented singular path.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings/ returns up to ten comparable listings — same locality, same bedroom count, price within 15%.
findings.actual: Endpoint returns 404 Not Found. No comparable or similarity endpoint exists on the server.
findings.impact: Similar property recommendations on detail pages must be computed client-side.

findings.documented: Logged-in users manage favorites at GET, POST, DELETE /v1/favourites with body {'id': '...'}.
findings.actual: All /v1/favourites paths return 404. The actual endpoint is /v1/saved, and POST /v1/saved requires body {'listing_id': '...'}.
findings.how_found: Probed /v1/favourites (404), discovered /v1/saved (200), and received 422 validation error requiring 'listing_id' when passing 'id'.
findings.impact: Saved property functionality fails with 404 and 422 errors.

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns pre-computed aggregates for your city.
findings.actual: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns 404 Not Found; no server-side analytics summary exists.
findings.impact: Analytics and insights metrics must be synthesized client-side from the listings catalog.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings accepts sort_by and order (asc or desc).
findings.actual: The 'order' query parameter is ignored by the server. Requesting order=desc returns records in the same order as order=asc.
findings.how_found: Queried /v1/listings?sort_by=price&order=desc and compared with order=asc; both returned identical records.
findings.impact: Users sorting high-to-low receive low-to-high results unless sorted client-side.

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
findings.actual: The project_id query parameter on GET /v1/listings is quietly ignored and returns unfiltered listings.
findings.how_found: Sent GET /v1/listings?project_id=P10001; server returned total: 4348 with listings from unrelated projects.
findings.impact: Filtering listings by builder project fails on the server and must be done client-side.

findings.documented: Timestamps are ISO 8601, UTC, with Z suffix everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: Listing posted_at values are local naive ISO 8601 strings without 'Z' suffix or timezone offset (e.g. '2026-06-15T02:33:00').
findings.how_found: Audited posted_at across all 4700 listing records; zero records contain a 'Z' suffix.
findings.impact: Datetime parsers expecting strict UTC with Z suffix fail or misinterpret the timestamps.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in integer Indian rupees.
findings.actual: In /v1/projects, price_min and price_max are float values in Crores (for values < 10) or Lakhs (for values >= 10), not integer rupees.
findings.how_found: Observed project price_max values like 2.95 (Crores) and 99.8 (Lakhs) while constituent listings are in tens of millions of rupees.
findings.impact: Raw display shows multi-crore luxury projects priced at 2 rupees.

findings.documented: Area is in square feet, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: MagicHomes listings report carpet_area and super_built_up_area in square meters when values are under 300.
findings.how_found: Found 389 MagicHomes listings with carpet_area < 300, matching standard Indian 1-4 BHK square meter dimensions (e.g. 77 sqm for a 2 BHK).
findings.impact: Price per square foot calculations are inflated tenfold (~180,000 INR/sqft) unless converted (* 10.7639) to square feet.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: Endpoint returns 978 inactive listings with an undocumented 'is_live': false field.
findings.how_found: Checked is_live across all 4700 records and found 978 records where is_live is False.
findings.impact: Frontends displaying all listings without filtering on is_live display expired and withdrawn properties.

findings.documented: Each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Cross-portal duplicate listings exist describing the same physical property with identical apartment, locality, floor, and bedroom layout.
findings.how_found: Identified 332 groups of listings sharing identical apartment_name, locality, floor, and bedroom count, containing 350 duplicate records.
findings.impact: Users see redundant listings for the identical flat across different broker portals.

findings.documented: total_listings is recomputed whenever a listing is added or withdrawn, so it always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
findings.actual: total_listings disagrees with the actual number of live listings available in /v1/listings for 127 projects.
findings.how_found: Counted live listings per project_id and compared with project.total_listings across all 520 projects.
findings.impact: Project total_listings count is out of sync with actual listings catalog.

findings.documented: Valid real estate sale listings describing physical properties.
findings.actual: Contains records describing physically and logically impossible properties: floor exceeding total floors, carpet area exceeding super built-up area, and negative sale prices.
findings.how_found: Audited physical constraints across all 4700 records: found 8 floor-exceeding records, 8 carpet-exceeding records, and 8 negative-price records.
findings.impact: Corrupts statistical metrics and breaks UI floor pickers and pricing displays.

findings.documented: Genuine sale listings with authentic market sale prices.
findings.actual: Contains fake listings posted with token prices equal to per-sqft rates (6,250 to 16,790 INR) designed to manipulate sorting and harvest user enquiries.
findings.how_found: Identified exactly 8 listings with prices < 1,000,000 INR where full property purchase price was entered as the sqft rate.
findings.impact: Misleads buyers and drastically skews price sort orders and averages.
